nodes.label: ADR-audit-0013: GPX Stream Adjacency via gpxIndex
Stream-Adjacency Predicate: curr.gpxIndex === prev.gpxIndex + 1
consecutivePairCount (stream-adjacent pairs only)
Temporal Tags: adjacentDuplicate / belowPrevValid (stream-row semantics)
Rationale: array adjacency does not equal stream adjacency when points are rejected

Audit ADR Template
ADR-correction-0001: MVP Correction Pipeline Architecture
Multipass Loop (proposals -> overlap -> coupling -> AND apply)
Spine Intervals (shared forward-run partition, recomputed after each mutating apply)
AND Gate: overlap-safe intersection coupling-safe -> apply
Rationale: single-pass apply insufficient when block apply unlocks new proposals
ADR-correction-0002: Participation Coverage Gate and noCorrectionTemporalAnomalies
coverageRatio / minTimestampPairCoverageRatio (default 0.8)
noCorrectionTemporalAnomalies Predicate (correction-idle: no reorder/backtrack work needed)
Participation Mode: geometry-only (zero parseable timestamps)
Rationale: separate gap bookkeeping (audit) from correction skip semantics
ADR-correction-0003: Handoff — workingOrderedPoints and Pre-Split Lists
workingOrderedPoints (mutable pipeline array)
correction.fullOrderedPoints (final traversal order after correction)
canonicalTrustedPoints (fullOrderedPoints minus drops and excludedFromTrust)
correction.excludedFromTrust (correction-only point exclusions)
Rationale: pre-split at export keeps downstream consumers cheap
ADR-correction-0004: Objective Adjacent Dedupe and Elevation Resolution
Elevation Resolution Rules (usable vs OOB, survivor ele=null)
Rationale: only stream-adjacent pairs safe to collapse without spine context
ADR-correction-0005: Full-Array Reversal — Candidacy and Acceptance
Endpoint Envelope Candidacy (tMax at first finite-timeMs row, tMin at last)
Rationale: hasAnyPositiveTimeDelta===false is ambiguous; endpoint envelope disambiguates
ADR-correction-0006: Overlap vs Referential Coupling; Block Reorder Kinematic Guard (revised)
block-finding Proposal (run span + internal monotonicity only)
socket-ok Status (B_min>=t_prev, B_max<=t_next, no spine pierce)
Structural Socket Guard: Corridor Spine Pierce Check (spinePointPierceDetected)
overlapBlockResolution[] (brackets, socket, blockReorderPayload)
Rationale: silently applying kinematically-bad block reorder poisons all downstream layers
ADR-correction-0007: Audit Modules vs Correction Participation (MVP)
Rationale: audit observes; correction acts and emits correction-specific exclusions
ADR-correction-0008: Proposal-Fed Overlap + Coupling (supersedes early chunk apply)
Rationale: uniform orchestration with one apply locus is preferable to two mutation points
ADR-correction-0009: Overlap-Detection Scope — Cross-Proposal Footprint Mapping
Cross-Kind Veto: singleton-insert inside block envelope -> overlap.singleton_block_conflict
Detect-and-Veto MVP Policy (no cross-kind resolution; multipass provides iterative recovery)
Rationale: implicit cross-kind vetoes create invisible correctness gaps
ADR-correction-0010: Coupling-Detection — Kinematic Reference Stability and Bilateral Disturbance Zones
Bilateral Disturbance Zones (leaving-side + arriving-side per proposal)
coupledRegions[] (connected components of coupling graph with full edge diagnostics)
Kinematic Traversal Neighbours (traversal-adjacent in workingOrderedPoints, not gpxIndex-adjacent)
Rationale: kinematic check against unstable neighbourhood is unreliable; block must wait
ADR-correction-0011: Three-Phase Pipeline — Per-Segment Terminal Solve
Phase 1: Per-Segment Terminal Solve (multipass, intra-segment coupling only)
Phase 2: Edge Reconciliation (single pairwise pass over segment boundaries after Phase 1)
Phase 3: Global Residual Diagnostic Sweep (read-only, telemetry only, never mutates)
multipassMaxIterations = 500 (per-segment safety net; hitting it is a defect signal)
correction.stagedEdgeProposals (edge proposals deferred from Phase 1 solve)
Rationale: per-segment isolation eliminates cross-segment order-dependent correction bugs
ADR-correction-0012: Schema Cleanup — drops, excludedFromTrust, annotations
correction.drops[] (physically removed points; absent from all ordered traces)
correction.annotations[] (replaces sessionFlags; session/segment/proposal scope; no trust effect)
Unified Insert Proposal Kind (replaces singleton-insert / duplicate-reorder / exact-group-flag-only)
KinematicCheck Schema (speedPrevKph, speedNextKph, score, thresholdKph, passed, failReason)
Partition Invariant: drops union excludedFromTrust union canonicalTrustedPoints = all gpxIndexes
Rationale: consumers need one place to check trust status; annotations are purely contextual
ADR-correction-0013: Boundary Classification Ownership — deterministic-export-fix in Correction
audit.ingestion.segmentBoundaries[] (raw observations: gapMs signed, no classification field)
deterministic-export-fix.js (correction-layer boundary classifier; owns chunk_ordering, duplicate_chunk, timestamp_discontinuity)
Boundary Class: chunk_ordering (backward gapMs, non-overlapping time ranges)
Boundary Class: duplicate_chunk (backward gapMs, materially overlapping time ranges)
Boundary Class: timestamp_discontinuity (whole-hour backward jump; flag only)
Boundary Class: segment_boundary_gap (forward gapMs; observation annotation only)
export-fault-detection.js (deprecated; classification moved to deterministic-export-fix.js)
Rationale: classification is correction policy; keeping it in audit violates observation-only contract
ADR-correction-0014: Traversal-Adjacent as Canonical Adjacency Primitive for Correction-Layer Dedupe
Two Adjacency Primitives: stream-adjacent (immutable raw input) vs traversal-adjacent (mutable current snapshot)
Segment Boundary as Hard Wall for Traversal Adjacency in Phase 1
Rationale: post-mutation stream-adjacent pairs no longer reflect forward-time story
ADR-correction-0015: Kinematic Guard Disposition — Gating vs Advisory-with-Fallback
Kinematic Guard Metric: speedPrev^2 + speedNext^2 (sum of squares); 80 kph per-speed threshold
Gating Policy: single-subject proposals (block-reorder, insert length=1) do not apply on guard failure
Advisory-with-Fallback: multi-candidate competition (insert length>=2) always resolves; least-bad wins
Rationale: asymmetric risk — single-subject has no forcing function; competition always must place someone

ADR-general-0001: Canonical Track as Single Source of Truth
Layered Model: raw observations -> canonical geometry -> elevation channels -> metric families
Rationale: honesty-first; no silent repair presented as raw truth
ADR-general-0002: Audit Layer Observation-Only and Post-Audit Pipeline Order
Post-Audit Pipeline Order: audit -> correction/flagging -> interpretation -> kinematic plausibility
Rationale: separate what data shows (audit) from what policy does about it (correction)
ADR-general-0003: Logbook Frontend Stack (Next.js, Mapbox GL, Tailwind, Recharts, Radix)
UI Honesty-First Principle: no generic SaaS template; data-quality visibility as product requirement
